summary: Add durable person-owned attention presentation-control registers to the store

replay.detail: Attention controls reduce replicated attention.control claims in canonical order. Explicit restore and snooze clears survive replay; newer source revisions invalidate suppression.

schema.detail: Register the durable attention.control claim and add an additive partial index for recipient, item and register lookups. No existing rows are rewritten.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or coordinated upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: The store exposes guarded control writes and indexed reads. Writes check source currency and control revision under the writer lock; same-key replay preserves the original receipt. Public inbox actions and serving behavior are unchanged.

downtime.detail: The additive index is created when opening the store.

recovery.detail: Control claims remain durable and do not complete or modify their source work.
